name: Mercure Bali Nusa Dua
short_description: A 198-room Mercure in the Nusa Dua enclave, set back from the beach with free shuttle access to the Mercure Beach Club and Bali Collection shopping.
ai_summary: Mercure Bali Nusa Dua sits within the gated Nusa Dua resort enclave, distinct from the beachfront Sofitel Bali Nusa Dua Beach Resort in the same area -- this property is set back from the shore, with a free shuttle to the Mercure Beach Club and Bali Collection shopping centre making up for the distance. Guests get free access to beach-club loungers and towel service, and reviews describe fair value for an upper-midscale hotel, but the set-back, relatively isolated location and small, functional rooms are recurring complaints alongside occasional cleanliness issues.

pros: Free shuttle to both the Mercure Beach Club and Bali Collection shopping centre
Free beach-club access with loungers, thatched huts and towel service
Large landscaped grounds spanning three hectares
Front-desk staff and management responsiveness draw specific praise
cons: Set back from the beach in a relatively isolated part of the Nusa Dua enclave, requiring the shuttle rather than a walk
Rooms run on the small side despite the resort-style grounds
Some reviews note housekeeping lapses and wear on walls and infrastructure
research_highlights: The free shuttle to the Mercure Beach Club and Bali Collection is repeatedly called the property's practical workaround for not being beachfront
Staff hospitality and management responsiveness draw specific praise
The three-hectare landscaped grounds are highlighted as a strength for the price point
research_watchouts: The set-back, relatively isolated location within Nusa Dua is a recurring complaint -- factor in the shuttle schedule
Some reviews describe housekeeping lapses and visible wear on walls and infrastructure

faqs.question: Is Mercure Bali Nusa Dua on the beach?
faqs.answer: No -- unlike its sister property, the beachfront Sofitel Bali Nusa Dua Beach Resort, this Mercure sits set back within the Nusa Dua enclave. It offsets that with a free shuttle to the Mercure Beach Club and free beach-club access with loungers and towel service.

faqs.question: Is Mercure Bali Nusa Dua good value?
faqs.answer: Many guests describe it as good value for an upper-midscale hotel in the gated Nusa Dua enclave, citing the landscaped grounds, beach-club shuttle and responsive staff, though rooms run small and a minority of reviews note housekeeping and maintenance lapses.
